claim: Shadow copies are not enabled on FSx for Windows File Server by default; to protect your data with shadow copies you must enable shadow copies and set up a shadow copy schedule, and shadow copies are not a substitute for backups.

evidence.quote: Shadow copies are *not* enabled on FSx for Windows File Server by default.
Shadow copies are not a substitute for backups.
To protect the data on your file system using shadow copies, you must enable shadow copies and set up a shadow copy schedule on your file system.
